machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, breadcrumb "Home / Dashboards / Bench / Service Health") has exactly 3 panels, in order:
1. `Request rate` (Time series)
2. `Error count` (Stat)
3. `Latency by endpoint` (Table)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** A new dashboard titled `fwgr74-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr74-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (TestData logo/branding on the query row, placeholder "TestData", A-series rendering values). Verified after a fresh page reload.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr74-n1 Notes` with content `Notes for run fwgr74-n1` (includes the runid). Verified after a fresh page reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` (added via Dashboard settings → General → Tags; confirmed present in settings after a reload) and its time range is `Last 6 hours`. The save drawer's "Update default time range" checkbox was explicitly ticked before saving, so the range is persisted in the saved dashboard — confirmed by reloading the bare URL and seeing Grafana itself restore `?from=now-6h&to=now` and the picker read "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval is `1m`. Set via the top-bar refresh picker, then saved with the save drawer's "Update default refresh value" checkbox ticked (the drawer reported "Changes 1" and saved). After reloading the bare URL, Grafana restored `&refresh=1m` and the picker reads "1m" ("Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's page location after navigating to the bare URL:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfz9vi4fv54aoe/fwgr74-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `bfz9vi4fv54aoe`. (Grafana normalises the bare URL by re-adding the time/refresh params, which is itself evidence the time range and refresh interval are persisted in the saved dashboard.)

Final read-only verification confirmed on the loaded page: breadcrumb "Home / Dashboards / fwgr74-n1 Bench Dashboard", panels `fwgr74-n1 Notes` and `fwgr74-n1 Availability`, time picker "Last 6 hours", refresh picker "1m", settings tag `bench`.
